Live, always-on virtual receptionist support
A ringing phone can be more than an interruption. It can be a new lead, a returning customer, or someone who needs an answer right now. Ruby’s live virtual receptionists help make sure those conversations don’t end in voicemail just because you’re with a client, finishing a job, or done for the day.
When a call routes to Ruby, a trained receptionist—not a bot—answers on your behalf. Coverage is available 24/7, including weekends and holidays, and you decide when Ruby steps in. We can answer every call, cover selected calls, or serve as backup when your team is unavailable.
Ruby receptionists can answer common questions, capture leads, schedule appointments, and connect callers according to your preferences. With managed live chat , real people can also engage website visitors and help capture opportunities.
Whether you’re a law firm, home services company, or small office, Ruby helps you stay responsive without staffing the phones around the clock. Explore businesses across industries or get started with Ruby .
Ruby FAQs
What is a virtual receptionist?
A virtual receptionist is a real person who answers calls on behalf of your business. Ruby’s receptionists can greet callers, answer frequently asked questions, capture lead information, schedule appointments, collect payments, connect calls and more according to your business’s preferences.
The goal isn’t simply to take a message. It’s to help resolve more of the caller’s needs during that first conversation whenever possible, while making sure they feel cared for from the first hello.
How much does a virtual receptionist cost?
Cost depends on the amount of receptionist time your business needs. Ruby offers plans based on monthly receptionist minutes, so a solo business and a growing team don’t have to purchase the same amount of coverage.
When comparing providers, look beyond the base rate and ask what may cost extra, including holiday coverage, bilingual answering, appointment scheduling, integrations, and setup. You can review Ruby’s plans and pricing to compare options and included features.
Are Ruby's virtual receptionists bilingual?
Yes. Ruby offers English-Spanish call handling with a bilingual virtual receptionist available 24/7. That gives Spanish-speaking and English-speaking callers the opportunity to speak with a real person rather than navigate an automated phone experience.
Does Ruby use AI or live receptionists?
Ruby uses live, human receptionists. An AI virtual receptionist that independently picks up and conducts the call isn’t how Ruby works. Instead, Ruby uses AI to support parts of the experience behind the scenes, including tools such as transcripts and AI-assisted call flows. The person speaking with your caller remains a trained human receptionist.
What's the difference between a virtual receptionist and basic call answering?
Basic call answering may end with taking a caller’s information or passing along a message. Ruby’s receptionists can do more during the conversation. Depending on your preferences, they can answer common questions, capture leads, schedule appointments, collect payments, and connect callers to you or another number. The goal is to help the caller accomplish more during the first interaction while reducing the administrative work that lands back on your team. In other words, the value isn’t just that someone picked up. It’s what they can help your caller accomplish once they do.

About Ruby
We turn first impressions into lasting loyalty.
Ruby’s people, technology, and service come together to deliver one-of-a-kind customer experiences.
Who we are
Since 2003, Ruby has been all about making personal connections that help small businesses grow. At the heart of everything we do is a promise to treat every moment of customer communication as an opportunity to make a lasting, positive impression. We are committed to the success of our customers, providing exceptional experiences—and a friendly, human touch—for the people they serve.
What we do
Ruby serves small businesses by delivering exceptional customer experiences for callers and website visitors. We’re a team of service-oriented professionals blended with an innovative tech company. Our highly trained receptionists use proprietary software and AI-supported call flows to personalize callers’ and website visitors’ experiences, answer FAQs, transfer callers, take messages, collect information, and more. Ruby’s tools allow our human team members to work efficiently and stay focused on providing amazing customer service while maximizing transparency for our business customers.
Live call answering

By providing small businesses with the services, products, and analytics they need to manage customer interactions, we save them time, reduce stress, and enable them to focus on what they do best.

No matter the topic or type of conversation, our team is able to turn even the most routine interactions into loyalty-winning moments for your business.

Any call—any business
We leverage proprietary software and artificial intelligence so that any receptionist who represents your business has real-time access to key details about your organization, industry, location, customers or clients, and more—so the person on the phone sounds like a seamless extension of your team.

Our culture
Ruby's vision and mission
Our vision
We deliver exceptional experiences that build customer loyalty and empower businesses to freely pursue their purpose, cultivating diverse and thriving local economies.
Our mission
We create meaningful connections and provide actionable insights that capture opportunities and give businesses the freedom over when and how they communicate so they can achieve more.
Ruby's core values
Every day at Ruby begins and ends with how we can serve our customers, which in turn benefits our communities and local economies.
Start from the heart.
We embrace kindness and empathy by approaching everything we do with compassion, respect, and an open mind. Rooted in transparency and vulnerability, the authentic relationships we build have a ripple effect that reaches far beyond Ruby.
Forge fearlessly.
We believe that stepping outside of our comfort zone and being unafraid to take chances can lead to great things. Bold yet thoughtful, we’re invigorated by possibility, undaunted by failure, and see every challenge as an opportunity to learn, adapt and innovate.
Rock your real.
We don’t just appreciate our differences, we celebrate them joyfully and honor them with curiosity and respect. When every individual can express themselves fully with honesty and courage, we foster a genuine sense of belonging where everyone feels seen, heard, and valued, enriching us all.
Own the impact.
We recognize that every action we take, no matter how big or small, has the potential to build trust, create positive outcomes, and make a difference. We value integrity and accountability in everything we do, celebrating our wins, acknowledging our missteps, and embracing our opportunities.
Cultivate growth.
We are inspired and driven to reach new milestones on our individual and collective journeys of growth and transformation. By always learning, humbly accepting feedback, and supporting each other, we grow and evolve together.
Create community.
Creating meaningful connections and fostering real relationships is at the heart of our culture and the reason small businesses choose Ruby. We recognize that it takes all of us contributing in small and big ways to build thriving, equitable communities within Ruby and beyond, and we are committed to doing this work.
The Ruby story
It all started with making connections.
In 2003, Ruby started as a small business dedicated to helping other small businesses. We were built on the belief that creating meaningful human connections in our technology-focused world would build trust, foster customer loyalty, and help our customers grow and thrive.
Fast-forward to 2023, and those values continue to shape every aspect of how we operate—both as individuals and as a company. Our small business beginnings help us understand the needs of the people we serve.
What was once a small, four-person business answering phones in a tiny studio has flourished into what we are today. Ruby employees care not only about the success of our customers, but are inspired by the businesses we serve and share in the joy of their accomplishments.
The Ruby approach
Ruby is the modern version of a hand-written thank you note.
Ruby makes meaningful connections in unexpected ways. We help our customers build great relationships. It’s because we know that first impressions build lasting loyalty, and that builds successful businesses.
Ruby is about doing something because it’s the right thing to do, not the thing we have to do. We’re about doing something because it’ll make someone’s day that much better. We do these little things because, even though they seem insignificant in their own right, they add up. They add up, they multiply, they expand exponentially. We do these things to brighten someone’s day. We do these things to remind our customers that we have their back. We do them all with heart.
The big thing that Ruby does is a hundred little things that make meaningful connections for our customers and that make moments matter.

Giving back
Ruby is committed to diverse and ongoing volunteer opportunities, donation drives, and financial support. When Ruby team members get together to help the community, great things happen!
People-powered positivity
Are you a people person? A gifted gabber? A capable conversationalist? Our team is made up of empathic problem solvers dedicated to supporting the success of our customers and their fellow Ruby team members. If that sounds like you, let’s chat!
